title: MicroPython Syntax Checker
description: Six snippets, two classic mistakes, and indentation drawn as visible guides so an off-by-one space is something you can see.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Raspberry Pi Pico, MicroPython, and the Moving Rainbow Kit

educational.audience: Mentors preparing to debug beginner code live

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a short MicroPython snippet, the learner identifies which lines are correctly formed and which would raise a SyntaxError or IndentationError.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Read a snippet, decide whether it runs, press Check
pedagogical.assessment: A pass through all six with the verdict called before pressing Check.
